qs.q: Lhamo and Norbu each order a cutlet (₹43) and a rasgulla (₹24). (a) Why is 2 × 43 + 24 wrong? (b) Write the correct expression. (c) Show it equals 2 × 43 + 2 × 24 and find the total. (d) What if Sangmu joins?
qs.ans: (a) It means 24 more than 2 × 43 — only one rasgulla paid (1 mark). (b) 2 × (43 + 24) (1 mark). (c) 2 × 67 = 134; 86 + 48 = 134, so equal (2 marks). (d) 3 × (43 + 24) = 3 × 67 = ₹201 (1 mark).

qs.q: Case study: A snail climbs 3 cm up a 10 cm post each day and slips down 2 cm each night. (a) How much does it gain in one day and night? (b) Write an expression for its height after 7 days and nights. (c) On which day does it reach the top? Explain why it is not day 10.
qs.ans: (a) 3 − 2 = 1 cm (1 mark). (b) 7 × (3 − 2) = 7 cm (1 mark). (c) On day 8 it climbs 3 cm: 7 + 3 = 10 cm, reaching the top (2 marks). It does not slip back after reaching the top, so it is not day 10 (1 mark).
